cross_fit.rule: a dataset and question type with at most max_folds scenes is cross-fitted leave one scene out (calibration: leave two out); with more, its scenes are grouped into max_folds folds balanced by row count and the same scheme runs on folds (calibration scores for a test scene come from scenes outside its fold, predicted without both folds)
